spec.name: Orange Pets guinea pig chocolate corrected eyes
spec.description: Original chocolate guinea pig preserved, with only its two front eye commands moved to symmetric positions on the head atlas.

prompt: Surgical texture-only correction to this generated guinea pig. The two front eyes are asymmetric and one is too close to the dark outer patch, making it look malformed. The flat_top_head cube uses uv [0,20], width=8,height=6,depth=6; its actual FRONT/north face is atlas x20..27 y26..31. Existing dark eye commands are single pixels at (23,28) and (26,28), colour #191717. Move these TWO eye commands ONLY to (22,28) and (25,28), giving symmetric columns 2 and 5 with clear space to the edges. Remove the old eye pixels by moving the commands, preserving underlying fur. Exactly two eyes total, no eyes on other faces, no highlights or outlines. Preserve ALL other texture commands/order/colours/pixels, atlas size, coat markings, muzzle and nose. Preserve every geometry coordinate, UV, element, bone, mob property and ALL animations exactly. Do not redesign. This is a four-pixel change only: (22,28),(23,28),(25,28),(26,28).
